name: Pasar Seni MRT Station, Entrance B

localName.text: Stesen MRT Pasar Seni, Pintu Masuk B

summary: The long, low hall at Entrance B of the Pasar Seni MRT station in central Kuala Lumpur, with dark upper walls and a glass end.

source.note: KL Rush’s procedural landmark, built from photos of the real building and exported in Chromium by npm run import.

notes: Built in code and exported with plain daytime materials and small painted textures, compressed for the web (meshopt geometry). Sizes are as modelled, not surveyed. A download copy will be exported from source once the model is cleared.

credits.note: Modelled on photos of the real building; likeness and trademark rights unchecked. Made by scripted agents.
